definition: smooth shiny cloth made from worm threads
description: In a fabric shop stacked with cloth, two women admire a length of shiny emerald-green silk: they let it pour like water, toss it into the air, press its smooth surface to their cheeks, and laugh as it keeps sliding off the polished counter while a white cat watches.
